title: Canary Rollout Under Delayed Failure Signals
strategies: single cautious one-shot cohort sized exactly at the risk-budget cap, never touching the rest of the horizon
exponential canary doubling: start small, double every stage while 'succeeding', paced against the previous stage's own size rather than the signal-latency window
latency-paced staging: per-step cohort size = W_v/(D_v*p_v), which keeps exactly the risk budget in flight at steady state and skips variants with negative expected value per device
mixed-integer / LP relaxation over the sliding-window admission constraints for a horizon-exact optimum
